<title level="1" right="Spell 8" pfs="Standard">
[Summon Warden of the Wild](/Spells.aspx?ID=1961)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Incarnate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=786" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 87

**Tradition**
[Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 100 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
see text

**Duration** until the end of your next turn
</row>

</column>

---

You briefly call forth the spirit of one of the Wardens of the Wild, the legendary guardians of nature. The warden occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature. When you Cast this Spell, you summon a warden depending on the biome in which the spell is cast (for instance, summoning the Warden of Caverns and Burrows if summoned in a cave, canyon, or other underground environment). In an unnatural environment, the warden summoned depends on the region's most recent or similar natural biome, as decided by the GM

- **Warden of Caverns and Burrows** Speed 60 feet, burrow 100 feet.**Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Obsidian Cage_ Obsidian stalagmites burst from the earth as the warden surfaces, impaling enemies and trapping them in stalagmites. Enemies on the ground within 40 feet take 6d6 piercing damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). Creatures that fail their save become [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) (the DC is your spell DC).**Depart** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Blessing of the Depths_ The squares occupied by the warden remain disheveled and broken, becoming [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366). The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with a [_mountain resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1610) and [_unfettered pack_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1733). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds, but the duration of _mountain resilience_ isn't reduced when an affected target is hit by a bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing attack.
- **Warden of Forests and Meadows** Speed 120 feet.**Arrive** ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) _Idyllic Panorama_ The warden's presence unpredictably warps the appearances and perceived distances of creatures and obstacles around it. Each time an enemy within 40 feet of the warden attempts a Strike or Stride action, it takes 4d6 mental damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Will save). On a critical failure, the creature Strikes a random target within reach or Strides in a random direction. On a critical success, the creature becomes temporarily immune for 1 round.**Depart** _Fox's Insightful Trickery_ The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with [_blur_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1455) and [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds.
- **Warden of Oceans and Rivers** Speed 60 feet, swim 120 feet.**Arrive** _I Am the Tide_ If the warden is summoned in a body of water, it creates a churning whirlpool that deals 10d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within 30 feet ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A creature that fails this save is [pulled](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 15 feet closer to the warden (30 feet on a critical failure). If the warden is summoned outside of a body of water, it creates a wave of water that deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within 30 feet ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A creature that fails this save is pushed 10 feet away from the warden.**Depart** _Acclimation to the Deep_ The warden affects you and your allies within 60 feet with [_feet to fins_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1525) and [_water breathing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1755). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds, but a creature affected by _feet to fins_ retains its normal land Speed.
- **Warden of Peaks and Skies** Speed 60 feet, fly 240 feet.**Arrive** _Precipice Plummet_ The warden appears, flying downward from the sky and sends a shockwave where she lands. Creatures within 20 feet take 10d6 sonic damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). Creatures that critically fail their saves are [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1.**Depart** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541)) _Song of the Skies_ The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with [_fly_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1534) and [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds.
